name: gantt-chart-visual
description: Atlyn Gantt Chart for Power BI

scripts.package: pbiviz package && powershell -Command "Remove-Item dist/atlynGanttChart.pbiviz -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem dist/*.pbiviz | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'atlynGanttChart.pbiviz' } | Select-Object -First 1 | Rename-Item -NewName atlynGanttChart.pbiviz -Force"
scripts.test:visual: npm run test:visual:build && npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run test:visual:build && npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.preview: npm run preview:build && npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
